# YARI.WTF

> Yari is an Atlanta music producer who makes underground, rage, Detroit, and melodic trap type beats and produces songs for independent artists. Beats are sold as leases and exclusives on Traktrain (https://traktrain.com/yariwtf), with leases from $15 and instant download.

## Buy beats
- [Beat store and previews](https://yari.wtf/beats): 14 beats live, leases from $15 (MP3, WAV, Premium, Unlimited, Exclusive), free tagged MP3s for HYBRID, SHE'S HOME, and RED.
- [Traktrain store](https://traktrain.com/yariwtf): checkout and instant download.

## Type beats by sound
- [Playboi Carti type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/playboi-carti): rage and vamp, 140 to 170 BPM.
- [Ken Carson type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/ken-carson): fast, distorted rage, 150 to 170 BPM.
- [Destroy Lonely type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/destroy-lonely): dark, melodic rage, 140 to 160 BPM.
- [Tezzus type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/tezzus): gritty underground, 140 to 170 BPM.
- [Diamond type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/diamond): bouncy underground, 140 to 170 BPM.
- [Rio Da Yung OG type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/rio-da-yung-og): Flint bounce, FLINT at 195 BPM.
- [OSAMASON type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/osamason): distorted rage, 150 to 170 BPM.
- [Nettspend type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/nettspend): hazy plugg, 140 to 160 BPM.
- [Che type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/che): chaotic rage, 150 to 170 BPM.
- [LUCKI type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/lucki): ambient, hypnotic loops.
- [Underground type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/underground): rage, plugg, and hazy beats.
- [Detroit type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/detroit): off-beat bounce, 90 to 100 or 180 to 200 BPM.
- [Babyface Ray type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/babyface-ray): smooth, soulful Detroit.
- [YTB Fatt type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/ytb-fatt): dark piano street rap.
- [Lil Baby type beats](https://yari.wtf/type-beats/lil-baby): melodic Atlanta trap, 140 to 155 BPM.

## Work with Yari
- [Start here](https://yari.wtf/start): short questionnaire that routes to the right beat license or a production call for custom beats and song production (Atlanta or remote).
- [About Yari](https://yari.wtf/about)
